title: Conditioned Medium from IFNγ-Pretreated Human Gingival Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Enhances the Immunomodulatory Effects on Neutrophils.
snippet: Introduction/ Objective: Neutrophils are crucial for an effective innate immune response.
